summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed Form 6-K to announce its total voting rights as of July 31, 2026, pursuant to the Transparency Regulations. The filing states that issued share capital comprises 1,037,964,753 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 0.006 each, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in the same number of voting-right shares. This disclosure provides a denominator for shareholders to use in notifying interests. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, capital return, or restructuring is present; the filing is a routine regulatory transparency notice.
